tactics: have key : ∀ l : List {x // p x}, (List.filter f l).unattach = List.filter g l.unattach := by intro l; induction l with | nil => rfl | cons a t ih => (rw [List.filter_cons, List.filter_cons, show f a = g a.val from hf a.1 a.2]; split <;> simp_all)
have hf' : ∀ y : {x // p x}, f y = g y.val := fun y => hf y.1 y.2
